description: Helix editor with tree-sitter syntax highlighting and LSP support

hx.description: Helix editor with tree-sitter syntax highlighting and LSP support
hx.usage:
hx file.rs # Edit Rust file with syntax highlighting
hx --health # Check LSP server status
hx --tutor # Interactive tutorial
Space+f - File picker, Space+b - Buffer picker, Ctrl+c - Command palette
